title: 19 武是杀人技20 帮你选择
content_zh:
……
梁松坐在石桌旁。
手里捧着一杯热茶，悠哉地看着林哲羽练拳。
当他看到林哲羽已经可以做到练拳时，配合内练呼吸法，眼睛不禁瞪大。
“我十几天前才教的内练呼吸法吧，竟练到这种程度了！”
梁松惊讶不已。
能够将呼吸法融入到拳法之中，只有参透呼吸法，并经过一番苦练才行。
一般的资质的武者，没几个月苦练都做不到。
天才点的，一个月左右就行。
而林哲羽仅仅用了十几天时间。
“这小子不愧是练武奇才啊！”
梁松感叹，心里都有些羡慕了。
想当初他初接触内练呼吸法时，将其融入武功中，足足花费了一个月的时间才做的。
而林哲羽还不到二十天的时间就可以了。
如此天才的武道苗子，竟让他在松宜城这种小地方碰到了，这还真是意外之喜。
“早知道之前教导他时就多上点心了。”
梁松小声嘀咕。
他仔细看着林哲羽的动作。
只见林哲羽两腿微张，身子下蹲，摆开了架势，身上一股无形的气场弥漫开来。
他脚猛地一踏，腿部肌肉猛然用力。

强大的力量从两腿传出，以腰部为纽带传导到双臂，紧接着上半身微微一斜，双拳携着强横无比的力量，如两根牛角般冲击而出。
全身肌肉，在这一瞬间爆发，力量灌入双臂，化为恐怖的攻势，双拳轰出。
噼啪——
拳头轰出的刹那，林哲羽身体中发出筋骨共鸣声。
二十几分钟后，一遍拳法打完。
啪啪啪——
“不错，非常不错。”梁松鼓掌赞许道。
“不过有几处地方需要注意下。”
“锻骨的练法和练肉的练法有轻微不同，不要按练肉境时的思维去锻炼。”
“首先，锻骨时需要在这里、这里，还有这里……”
梁松开始指点，指出林哲羽刚刚练拳时需要改进的地方。
若没有人教导，这些细节和注意事项需要经过一番苦功夫才能够摸索出来。
林哲羽听着梁师傅的解说，眼睛越来越亮。
若是没有梁松今天的教导，林哲羽或许需要下一次进入那种特殊状态后，经过漫长的锻炼才能够逐渐摸索出来。
“好了，再打一遍看看。”梁松说道。
content_en:
…
Liang Song sat at the stone table.
Holding a cup of hot tea in his hand, he leisurely watched Lin Zheyu practice boxing.
When he saw that Lin Zheyu could already practice boxing and practice internal breathing techniques, his eyes widened.
"I just taught you the internal breathing method more than ten days ago, and I've actually practiced it to this extent!"
Liang Song was surprised.
The ability to integrate breathing techniques into boxing can only be achieved by thoroughly understanding the breathing techniques and practicing hard.
A martial artist with average qualifications can't do it even after a few months of hard training.
It’s a genius idea, and it will only take about a month.
Lin Zheyu only spent more than ten days.
"This kid is truly a martial arts prodigy!"
Liang Song sighed, feeling a little envious in his heart.
I remember that when he first came into contact with the internal breathing method, it took him a full month to integrate it into martial arts.
And Lin Zheyu has less than twenty days to go.
It was an unexpected surprise that he encountered such a talented martial arts seedling in a small place like Songyicheng.
"If I had known earlier, I would have paid more attention when teaching him."
Liang Song whispered.
He watched Lin Zheyu's movements carefully.
Lin Zheyu's legs were slightly spread, his body was squatting, and he was in a posture. An invisible aura filled the air.
He stepped hard with his foot, and his leg muscles tightened suddenly.
Powerful power came from both legs, and was transmitted to both arms using the waist as a link. Then the upper body tilted slightly, and the fists, carrying extremely tyrannical power, struck out like two horns.
The muscles of the whole body exploded at this moment, and the power poured into the arms, turning into a terrifying offensive, and punched out with both fists.
crackling——
The moment his fist exploded, Lin Zheyu's body resonated with his muscles and bones.
Twenty minutes later, one punch was completed.
Bang bang bang——
"Not bad, very good." Liang Song applauded and praised.
"But there are a few things you need to pay attention to."
"The training method for bone training is slightly different from the training method for muscle training. Don't exercise according to the thinking of training in the meat state."
"First of all, when forging bones, you need to be here, here, and here..."
Liang Song began to give instructions, pointing out the areas that Lin Zheyu needed to improve when he first practiced boxing.
If there is no one to teach you, these details and precautions will take a lot of hard work to figure out.
Lin Zheyu's eyes became brighter and brighter as he listened to Master Liang's explanation.
Without Liang Song's teaching today, Lin Zheyu might need to enter that special state next time and then gradually figure it out after a long period of training.
"Okay, let's try it again." Liang Song said.
